description: Defines the QuicFlowController class and related interfaces for managing flow control in QUIC streams and connections, including window updates, flow control violation detection, and auto-tuning of receive windows.

classes.name: QuicFlowControllerInterface
classes.description: Interface for flow control operations, ensuring minimum window size.

classes.name: QuicFlowController
classes.description: Implements flow control logic for QUIC streams and connections, including window management, flow control violation detection, and auto-tuning.

methods.name: EnsureWindowAtLeast
methods.description: Ensures the flow control window is at least the specified size.

methods.name: UpdateHighestReceivedOffset
methods.description: Updates the highest received byte offset from the peer.

methods.name: AddBytesConsumed
methods.description: Increments the count of bytes consumed locally.

methods.name: AddBytesSent
methods.description: Increments the count of bytes sent to the peer.

methods.name: UpdateSendWindowOffset
methods.description: Updates the send window offset and returns whether the flow control state changed to unblocked.

methods.name: SendWindowUpdate
methods.description: Informs the peer of a new receive window.

methods.name: FlowControlViolation
methods.description: Checks if flow control limits have been violated by the peer.

methods.name: MaybeSendBlocked
methods.description: Sends a BLOCKED frame if flow control limits are reached.

methods.name: UpdateReceiveWindowSize
methods.description: Updates the size of the receive window, potentially auto-tuning it.
